_comment: Showcase demo seed (#107). Operator-editable: titles, descriptions and links. Every person except the Operator (Njuguna Njenga) is fictional; every row is demo data. Entry order is gallery order (the first entry shows first). Links must be https:// (no localhost or IP literals); pitchVideoUrl is a YouTube link or null. Builder ids must start with demo- and never change once seeded. Skills come from the nine-skill vocabulary and never include mobile. Run: uv run python scripts/seed_showcase_demo.py

entries.title: Venture Route
entries.description: Turns a founder's venture brief into a staffing route: the verified builders, partner and cohort fit, reusable IP and the gaps, each with the reasoning path MeTTa matched. Built for the Basix ecosystem.

entries.title: Crop price SMS digest
entries.description: A daily SMS digest of market prices for maize, beans and tomatoes across county markets, so smallholder farmers know where to sell before they travel.

entries.title: School fees tracker
entries.description: Parents see what they owe and what they paid per term; bursars reconcile mobile money receipts against a class list in one screen. Licensable to school networks.
